name: Expanded Enhance Arrows (Mythic)
body:
You can confer nearly any power to your arrows and bow.

Prerequisite(s): Expanded Enhance Arrows.

Benefit(s): You gain the mythic enhance arrows ability, as seen under Mythic Arcane Archer Options. If you already have that ability or gain it later, you add the following qualities to the ones you can grant to your arrows or bow: brilliant energy, greater designating, heart-piercing, speed, tailwind.
